newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea prepares welcome for 17 N.Korean defectors.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea prepares welcome for 17 N.Korean defectors.

text.p: The largest ever group of North Koreans to flee the communist nation will arrive in South Korea on Monday from Hong Kong to take up political asylum, a foreign ministry spokesman said.

The 16 members of one family and one security guard who arrived in Hong Kong on November 23 after a month-long trek across China are scheduled to leave the British colony on a scheduled Korean Airlines flight.
The defectors will board the flight at 12.50 p.m. Hong Kong time (0450 GMT), spokesman Kwak Sung-kyu said.
The biggest mass escape from North Korea since the end of the 1950-53 Korean War has raised new fears in the South about whether its Stalinist neighbour is cracking up.

A mass refugee exodus from North Korea, signalling a breakdown of internal controls -- similar to the German experience -- is part a nightmare scenario for Seoul, which would be left to pick up the pieces from any collapse in Pyongyang.
On Sunday, South Korean media reported that two North Koreans, at least one an intelligence agent, were also in Hong Kong seeking asylum.
